item.title: Launchy 2026.9
item.description:
A maintenance release focused on Dock and focus behavior, folder management, and click and scroll handling, plus a round of code cleanup and wiki improvements.

Features

  • NEWAdded “Delete folder” and “Remove from folder” actions (localized)

Fixes

  • FIXFixed the Dock icon reappearing when “Hide Dock icon” is enabled (#21)
  • FIXFixed focus handover when the launcher opened from the Dock is dismissed, and made Launchy claim activation on Dock reopen (#22)
  • FIXFixed Floaty mode losing its selection when the presentation check fails (#20)
  • FIXFixed the launcher reopening when an app launched from it quits (#23)
  • FIXFixed folder names not refreshing after a rename, folders reopening with settings open, and folder details
  • FIXRestored focus to the previous app synchronously on dismiss
  • FIXLimited the app icon hit area to the icon and its label (#19)
  • FIXFixed mouse wheel paging in horizontal mode, which now follows natural scrolling (#17)
  • FIXRegistered the page-arrow hitboxes so clicks no longer dismiss the launcher

Maintenance

  • IMPROVERemoved dead code, unreachable OS fallbacks, and unused strings

Documentation

  • IMPROVEDocumented “Remove from folder” and “Delete folder” in the wiki
  • IMPROVEFixed wiki inaccuracies and added a Tips and Tricks page

Launchy is the free open-source Launchpad alternative macOS users have been waiting for. Fullscreen mode mirrors the classic Launchpad experience but adds richer controls, while Floaty Mode doubles as a HUD with fast toggles that match the new macOS design without changing the behavior you rely on. It scans your apps, caches icons, and keeps a responsive grid ready on every Space - a universal binary that runs natively on both Apple Silicon (M-series) and Intel Macs, all completely free.
